# Write architecture

> Writes a Gradatim project's architecture, runbook and agent docs from the stack and structure the user chooses, recording each choice. It designs nothing on its own. Use when the user asks for Gradatim's architecture step, to choose or change the stack or the structure, or to add an agent doc.

| | |
|---|---|
| Skill | `write-architecture`, [its file](../../skills/write-architecture/SKILL.md) |
| Step | 5 of 14: architecture |
| Runs | After the concept; again for a changed stack |
| Next | new sprint |
| Call it | `/gradatim:write-architecture` on Claude Code; [the other hosts](install.md#calling-a-skill) |

## When to use it

- The user asks for Gradatim's architecture step, or to choose the stack and the structure of the project.
- The user wants to change the stack or the structure, or to add an agent doc for a topic the project now has.
- Not for a change to what the project does, or to a decision that holds other than the stack: that is [`decide-direction`](decide-direction.md). Not for the plan's stories, cut, order or estimates: that is [`write-concept`](write-concept.md). Not for facts a choice needs: that is [`research-topics`](research-topics.md). Not for sprints: that is [`new-sprint`](new-sprint.md). Not for a folder with no Gradatim project: that is [`init-project`](init-project.md).

## What it reads and writes

| Document | Path | Use |
|---|---|---|
| Agent file | `AGENTS.md` | reads, changes |
| Research index | `docs/research/README.md` | reads |
| Research report | `docs/research/NN-<topic>.md` | reads |
| Decisions index | `docs/decisions/README.md` | reads, changes |
| Decision session | `docs/decisions/NN-<topic>.md` | reads, changes |
| Architecture's records | `docs/decisions/architecture.md` | reads, creates, changes |
| Concept | `docs/MAIN_CONCEPT.md` | reads |
| MVP | `docs/MVP.md` | reads |
| Phase | `docs/PHASE-<k>.md` | reads |
| Architecture | `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` | reads, creates, changes |
| Runbook | `docs/RUNBOOK.md` | reads, creates, changes |
| Agent docs | `docs/agents/<topic>.md` | reads, creates, changes |

It also reads the project's own code and files, and changes none of them. It changes `AGENTS.md` and the index only at the yes, and in a decision session adds only a forward note. [The sync](../../skills/method/references/sync.md) changes what its own table lists. It writes nothing to git.
